title: Located a real person outside of mall world
content: I’ve been going to Mall World, or my version for at least 15 years. It started out as an expansive piece of property, grassland somewhat hilly with a view of a vibrant blue circular lake directly center of anywhere in the property. On the first night I was walking down the hillside with a person (important to note I had met him one other time 10 years prior in another dream during a significant life event), this person was discussing the plans for the property, stating “This is where it will be.” The next night, the nightly dreams and nightly visits to mall world started, beginning with land preparation, planning, and then simple buildings like small roadside wooden diners. Once the building of the town was underway, time sped up. One night I would be assigned to work in the Wild West style type of diner building, the next night it was overtaken by vegetetion, collapsed in a pile. Every night, same thing. I can identify parts of town and upon original planning, but now there are new buildings in place. Town has become a city, I know exactly how to get around town, I remember the older versions of the plan and start to miss the places I used to love to visit. I am able to remember in a way that I can see the old plans under the many layers of new city plans, and at this point there are hundreds/thousands(?) of versions of the city. I mainly work at the hospital, I have free access around town until I get close to an exit, then I become restricted in movement or the city develops its own blocks like backwards stairways or roads that become water logged tubes, or I’ve missed my plane at the airport because of delays. The city/mall world has the ability to keep me trapped. I’ve stayed at the pink hotel/motel, I am always confused when I’m there. I’ve also come across the dark hair woman in the white gown that I’ve read about in some of your posts. I think she controls by putting a white glue like substance in my mouth, I have to pull it out to speak. There are times when the Mall World has daylight, and times when it is dark and wet. Those are the times when I enounter people who have died in my life, and when I work the most at the hospital. Getting to the point of the post - one night I was tasked at the hospital with leading a physician around on a tour. We toured the hospital, got him a name badge. He was so upset and confused about being there. He wanted to leave and asked why he was there. I shrugged, handed him his badge and said, “well…you work here now.” We walked out of the side door to show him the employee parking, we were almost hit by a car in the dark, wet parking lot. He dropped his badge, I picked it up and looked at his photo, name, and job title (cardiologist). Then I woke up suddenly. Googled his name and his job title, his name came up as an Austrian cardiologist. I clicked Google images, it was him. This hasn’t happened to me since. Has this happened to anyone else?
